mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, we are looking at a comfortable 77 degrees with clear skies near the Verona Public Library.

The City of Verona has reached a major milestone with the unanimous adoption of the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan, which serves as a long-range roadmap for city development, housing, and infrastructure. Additionally, the city continues to provide ongoing engineering reports to the Common Council to keep our local utility and street projects on track.

We have plenty of ways to stay active this week. Yoga at Insight Wellness is happening today, followed by a full slate of activities tomorrow, including trivia at Hop Haus and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus the Downtown Farmer's Market on Tuesday.
Regarding recent incidents, on September 28, a motor vehicle accident occurred on CTH-PB at CTH-M, resulting in a citation for failure to control a vehicle.
Today's flavor of the day is Georgia Peach, and it is a must-try. The store is currently open for business and will remain open until 10 PM this evening.
